reading: The Welsh government is soliciting public input on a new state-owned renewable energy entity.
This initiative aims to mitigate energy costs over time by developing and owning renewable energy assets and supporting local and community ownership.
Furthermore, it would endeavor to attract investment into Welsh energy infrastructure and facilitate more organizations using locally generated energy.
Currently, ministers are proposing to integrate Trydan Gwyrdd Cymru (TGC), an existing onshore wind and solar developer, with other Welsh energy schemes like Ynni Cymru.
The consolidation seeks to create a single entity possessing the necessary expertise and critical mass of resources to effect significant change in the energy sector.
Despite its objective to reduce expenses, the consultation states that the company would not replace existing energy suppliers or directly determine household electricity prices.
Enterprise Minister Adam Price articulated a vision for Wales to have an energy system that is "clean, cheap and owned by us."

Price contrasted this modern ambition with Wales's historical position as an "energy giant" during the Industrial Revolution, lamenting that the benefits of coal were not primarily derived by its own populace.
He emphasized the imperative to avoid repeating such oversights with the immense potential presented by the contemporary renewable energy revolution.
While many energy policy levers are determined at a UK level, Price suggested a public energy company could facilitate lower prices through specific agreements with large local energy consumers.
The consultation also explores establishing a Welsh Energy Wealth Fund, intended to ensure energy project benefits reach vulnerable individuals and communities affected by project implementation.
Furthermore, the new entity might acquire stakes in substantial energy ventures, including offshore wind, marine energy, and nuclear power.
However, the proposals have faced scrutiny and criticism from political opponents such as the Welsh Conservatives and Reform parties.

Janet Finch-Saunders, Welsh Conservative energy spokesperson, challenged the government's focus, stating that another state-owned company and more turbines are not the answer amidst manufacturing job losses.
She asserted that Wales requires "cheap, reliable energy to keep factories open, businesses competitive and household bills down."

Jason O'Connell, Shadow Cabinet Minister, echoed similar concerns, questioning the priority of building a publicly owned energy entity over actively lowering current high energy bills for Welsh families.

vocabulary.definition: Asking for or trying to obtain something from someone, often formally or persistently.
A thing with distinct and independent existence, especially a distinct organization or legal body.
To obtain ownership or control of something, such as an asset or a share in a project.
To make something less severe, serious, or painful; to reduce the adverse effects or impact of something.
To try hard to do or achieve something, implying effort and often difficulty.
To combine one thing with another so that they become a whole, or to become part of a whole.
The action or process of combining a number of things or entities into a single, more effective, or coherent whole.
The amount of resources, expertise or support needed for an activity to become effective or successful.
Expressed an idea or feeling fluently and coherently; gave clear expression to.
Expressing regret or disappointment about something that has happened.
An essential or urgent thing; a command or duty that is extremely important.
To make an action or process easy or easier.

entries.ja: 誰かから何かを、しばしば公式にまたはしつこく、求めたり入手しようとすること。
entries.ko: 공식적으로 또는 끈질기게 누군가에게 무언가를 요청하거나 얻으려고 노력하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 通常以正式或坚持不懈的方式，向某人请求或试图从某人那里获取某物。
entries.es: Pedir o intentar obtener algo de alguien, a menudo de forma formal o persistente.
entries.pt-BR: Pedir ou tentar obter algo de alguém, muitas vezes de forma formal ou persistente.

entries.ja: 独自で独立した存在を持つもの、特に独自の組織や法人。
entries.ko: 명확하고 독립적인 존재를 가진 것, 특히 독자적인 조직이나 법인.
entries.zh-Hans: 具有独特和独立存在的事物，尤指独特的组织或法人实体。
entries.es: Una cosa con existencia distinta e independiente, especialmente una organización o entidad legal distinta.
entries.pt-BR: Uma coisa com existência distinta e independente, especialmente uma organização ou entidade legal distinta.

entries.ja: 資産やプロジェクトの株式など、何かの所有権や支配権を得ること。
entries.ko: 자산이나 프로젝트 지분과 같이 무언가의 소유권이나 통제권을 얻는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 获得某物的所有权或控制权，例如资产或项目中的股份。
entries.es: Obtener la propiedad o el control de algo, como un activo o una participación en un proyecto.
entries.pt-BR: Obter a propriedade ou o controle de algo, como um ativo ou uma participação em um projeto.

entries.ja: 何かをより厳しくなく、深刻でなく、または痛くなくすること。何かの悪影響や衝撃を軽減すること。
entries.ko: 무언가를 덜 심각하거나 고통스럽게 만들고, 무언가의 부정적인 영향이나 충격을 줄이는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某事不那么严峻、不那么严重或不那么痛苦；减少某事的不利影响或冲击。
entries.es: Hacer que algo sea menos severo, grave o doloroso; reducir los efectos adversos o el impacto de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar algo menos severo, sério ou doloroso; reduzir os efeitos adversos ou o impacto de algo.

entries.ja: 努力と困難を伴うことを示唆しながら、何かをしようと懸命に努めること。
entries.ko: 노력과 종종 어려움을 수반하며, 무언가를 하거나 성취하기 위해 열심히 노력하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 努力去做或实现某事，暗示着付出努力并常常伴随困难。
entries.es: Intentar con mucho esfuerzo hacer o lograr algo, implicando esfuerzo y a menudo dificultad.
entries.pt-BR: Tentar com muito esforço fazer ou alcançar algo, implicando esforço e muitas vezes dificuldade.

entries.ja: あるものを別のものと組み合わせて全体にする、または全体の一部になること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 다른 것과 결합하여 전체가 되게 하거나, 어떤 것의 일부가 되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 将一物与另一物结合，使其成为一个整体，或成为整体的一部分。
entries.es: Combinar una cosa con otra para que se conviertan en un todo, o para pasar a formar parte de un todo.
entries.pt-BR: Combinar uma coisa com outra para que se tornem um todo, ou para se tornar parte de um todo.

entries.ja: 多くの物や存在を単一の、より効果的または首尾一貫した全体に結合する行為または過程。
entries.ko: 여러 가지 또는 여러 실체를 단일하고 더 효과적이거나 일관성 있는 전체로 결합하는 행동 또는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 将多项事物或实体合并为一个单一的、更有效或更连贯的整体的行动或过程。
entries.es: La acción o el proceso de combinar varias cosas o entidades en un todo único, más efectivo o coherente.
entries.pt-BR: A ação ou o processo de combinar várias coisas ou entidades em um todo único, mais eficaz ou coerente.

entries.ja: ある活動が効果的または成功するために必要な資源、専門知識、または支援の量。
entries.ko: 어떤 활동이 효과적이거나 성공적이기 위해 필요한 자원, 전문 지식 또는 지원의 양.
entries.zh-Hans: 一项活动变得有效或成功所需的资源、专业知识或支持的数量。
entries.es: La cantidad de recursos, experiencia o apoyo necesarios para que una actividad sea efectiva o exitosa.
entries.pt-BR: A quantidade de recursos, experiência ou apoio necessários para que uma atividade se torne eficaz ou bem-sucedida.

entries.ja: 考えや感情を流暢かつ首尾一貫して表現した。明確に表現した。
entries.ko: 생각이나 감정을 유창하고 일관되게 표현했다; 명확하게 표현했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 流利而连贯地表达了思想或感受；给予了清晰的表达。
entries.es: Expresar una idea o un sentimiento de manera fluida y coherente; dar una expresión clara a algo.
entries.pt-BR: Expressar uma ideia ou um sentimento de forma fluente e coerente; dar expressão clara a.

entries.ja: 起こったことについて後悔や失望を表明すること。
entries.ko: 발생한 일에 대해 후회나 실망을 표현하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 对已经发生的事情表示遗憾或失望。
entries.es: Expresar arrepentimiento o decepción por algo que ha sucedido.
entries.pt-BR: Expressar arrependimento ou decepção sobre algo que aconteceu.

entries.ja: 不可欠または緊急なこと。非常に重要な命令または義務。
entries.ko: 필수적이거나 긴급한 것; 극히 중요한 명령 또는 의무.
entries.zh-Hans: 一项必要或紧急的事情；一项极其重要的命令或职责。
entries.es: Algo esencial o urgente; un mandato o deber extremadamente importante.
entries.pt-BR: Uma coisa essencial ou urgente; um comando ou dever que é extremamente importante.

entries.ja: 行動やプロセスを容易にする、またはより容易にすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 행동이나 과정을 쉽게 또는 더 쉽게 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某项行动或过程变得容易或更容易。
entries.es: Hacer que una acción o proceso sea fácil o más fácil.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar uma ação ou processo fácil ou mais fácil.

entries.ja: 批判的な観察または検査。
